purpose: Part 1/2 of verified hard-tail 10-record item effect batch 021; together these files contain exactly 10 reviewed records with complete captured mechanics.

items/icy-burst-150.name: Icy Burst
items/icy-burst-150.effectSummary: An icy burst weapon has the frost property and deals extra cold damage on a successful critical hit: +1d10 for ×2, +2d10 for ×3, or +3d10 for ×4 critical multipliers. Ranged weapons pass the cold energy to their ammunition, and the burst damage applies on critical hits even when the frost ability is inactive.

items/ocular-gems.name: Ocular Gems
items/ocular-gems.effectSummary: Only beholders can use ocular gems, replacing eyestalks to gain supernatural eye rays with 150-foot range unless noted. Available gems provide mind fog (Will DC 17), poison (Fortitude DC 16), ray of exhaustion (Fortitude DC 14), or stone to flesh (Fortitude DC 19); a beholder can use multiple gems by retracting additional eyestalks.

items/spell-trapping-466.name: Spell Trapping
items/spell-trapping-466.effectSummary: The ability continuously increases the armor's spell resistance by 2. Once per day, when a targeted spell of 5th level or lower fails to overcome that armor-granted spell resistance, the wearer can use an immediate action to trap it; the armor holds one spell at a time, preserves it exactly as cast, can dismiss it as a standard action, and can release it as a standard action that provokes attacks of opportunity.

items/spellflinging-spear.name: Spellflinging Spear
items/spellflinging-spear.effectSummary: The weapon is a Small +1 returning spell-storing spear. As a swift action, command words can elongate it into a longspear, shorten it into a shortspear, or restore normal spear form; its weight, hardness 12, and 20 hit points remain unchanged in every form. More powerful variants can add distance and/or gnome bane.

items/thought-bottle.name: Thought Bottle
items/thought-bottle.effectSummary: A thought bottle can hold five thoughts or memories, one creature's current experience total, or one prepared-spell collection. Storing or retrieving takes a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity; stored thoughts/memories leave the user's detailed memory, stored experience costs 500 XP and can later restore that creature's XP to the stored total, and prepared spells are expended when stored but can later be retrieved for normal preparation.
